name: IC — Septentrio
description: IC cluster featuring SMD parts with Septentrio mosaic LGA footprints from SparkFun GNSS libraries.
selection_hints: Select when using SMD Septentrio mosaic LGA or Septentrio_mosaic-G5_LGA54 footprints.
Choose among mosaic-G5_P3, mosaic-T, and mosaic-X5 parts depending on footprint requirements.
Verify part footprint assignment from the SparkFun-GNSS library source.
avoid_when: Through-hole mounting or non-SMD layout is required.
The PCB design requires packages other than Septentrio mosaic LGA.
Components outside the SparkFun GNSS Septentrio family are needed.
